name: Sakutto Panda ~Onihebi~
source:
Woman hands publisher a picture of what happened five years ago. Those events are depicted from nine different perspectives of nine main characters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位女士递给出版商一张五年前发生的事情的照片。这些事件是从九个主要人物的九个不同角度描述的。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
